summary_full: Beavers newly introduced in Dorset have remarkably transformed a woodland area into a flourishing wetland. Through their natural dam-building, these creatures have slowed down water movement, resulting in the formation of deep pools. This ecological shift has rejuvenated the local fauna, reintroducing various native species to the Purbeck region. Additionally, the beaver dams serve to mitigate flooding on nearby roads during heavy rains, highlighting nature’s essential contribution to environmental resilience.
